title: claimYieldFeeShares zeroes the entire yieldFeeBalance regardless of shares claimed
description: Discovery: Q3.2 / Q1.1 (paired accounting). claimYieldFeeShares(_shares) mints only _shares to the fee recipient but subtracts the whole cached _yieldFeeBalance from yieldFeeBalance instead of _shares. A partial claim therefore deletes the unclaimed remainder of the fee entitlement.
root_cause: Line 617 uses `yieldFeeBalance -= _yieldFeeBalance` (the full cached balance) rather than `-= _shares`, so the debt counter drops by more than the shares minted.

harm.loses_what: all accrued fee shares not included in a partial claim; the corresponding assets become ordinary liquidatable yield

exploit_trace: 2. yieldFeeRecipient calls claimYieldFeeShares(100); 100 shares are minted to it.
3. yieldFeeBalance is set to 1000 - 1000 = 0, so the remaining 900 shares of entitlement are no longer in totalDebt.
4. The 900 assets of backing are now counted as available yield and are liquidated for prizes; the fee recipient can never claim them.

preconditions.text: yieldFeeBalance > 0 and recipient claims fewer shares than the balance

postconditions.text: totalDebt understated relative to minted shares plus remaining fee entitlement

rules_applied: R10:✓(worst state is partial claim of 1 share)

title: convertToShares and maxRedeem revert (division by zero) when totalAssets is zero but debt is nonzero
description: Discovery: Q5.2 / Q5.6 (boundary). In the undercollateralised branch, mulDiv(totalDebt_, _totalAssets) divides by zero when the yield vault has lost everything (totalAssets == 0). ERC4626 requires convertToShares and maxRedeem not to revert, so integrators querying them in total-loss state get reverts.
root_cause: No guard for _totalAssets == 0 in the lossy branches of convertToShares/maxRedeem (previewWithdraw explicitly reverts with ZeroTotalAssets, but these view helpers do not handle it).

harm.loses_what: view calls revert in total-loss state
harm.magnitude: liveness of integrations only; no fund loss

exploit_trace: 1. Underlying yield vault loses all assets so totalAssets() == 0 while totalSupply > 0.
2. Anyone calls convertToShares(x) or maxRedeem(holder) where holder shares > 0.
3. mulDiv reverts on division by zero instead of returning a value.

preconditions.text: yield vault total loss (README says yield vaults are not expected to lose assets)
